steps: Mix flour, sesame oil, and ginger into a smooth dough.
Roll out the dough thinly and cut into diamond shapes.
Pan-fry the dough pieces in oil until golden and crisp.
Drain excess oil on paper towels to keep texture light.
Heat honey and water in a pot to create a thin syrup.
Toss the fried cookies in syrup until coated and glossy.
Blend ice, milk, and base drink ingredients in the blender.
Crumble the yakgwa over the top of the cold drink.

swaps.why: Shop lacks a fryer; shallow frying achieves similar crispness with less oil.
Easier to handle as a topping for drinks and prevents sogginess.

plan.caption: We tried the Korean yakgwa trend and made it local. Crispy honey-ginger cookies crumbled over your favourite iced kopi or teh tarik. Sweet, crunchy, and perfect for hot days. Come taste the crunch! #SingaporeFood #AhSengDrinks
plan.offer: Buy any drink, get a free yakgwa crumble topping.
